articles.title: Salesforce to acquire Informatica for $8 billion to enhance AI data tools
articles.summary: Salesforce plans to acquire data management platform Informatica for approximately $8 billion, aiming to bolster its AI capabilities across business tools.

articles.title: Nvidia earnings to reveal impact of US export curbs on China
articles.summary: Nvidia is set to report earnings amid significant impact from U.S. export restrictions on AI chip sales to China, potentially costing the company $5.5 billion.

articles.title: German consortium in talks to build AI data center
articles.summary: A German consortium, including SAP and Deutsche Telekom, is discussing building a major AI data processing center to secure EU funding.

articles.title: TSMC to open European chip design center in Munich
articles.summary: TSMC will open a new chip design center in Munich, Germany, focusing on AI and IoT applications, supporting European clients.

articles.title: European defense companies scramble for AI experts amid business boom
articles.summary: European defense firms face labor shortages, including AI experts, as military spending surges across the continent.

articles.title: Autonomous agents and profitability to dominate AI agenda in 2025
articles.summary: Executives forecast that autonomous agents and profitability will be central to the AI agenda in 2025, with advancements in step-by-step reasoning.

articles.title: World leaders set to vie for AI domination at Paris summit
articles.summary: Representatives from 80 countries, including world leaders and tech executives, will gather in Paris to discuss AI progress and future goals.
